name: Time To Ready
author: Decent Espresso
description: Examines current machine state and reports estimated time until it's ready for brewing

Stabilisation.description: Time in minutes after machine has heated up, to be considered truly ready. Only shown here as example

remainingTimeMs.description: number of milliseconds estimated until the machine is ready to brew.

heatingRate.description: The rade at which the machine is heating up.

name: Visualizer upload
author: Decent Espresso
description: Uploads shots to Visualizer and syncs your edited shot metadata back

LengthThreshold.description: Only upload shots that are longer than the threshold (in seconds)

BackSync.description: Sync metadata you edit on Visualizer (notes, TDS, EY, enjoyment, bean/grinder) back onto your local shots. Only your own uploaded shots are touched.

BackSyncIntervalSeconds.description: How often to check Visualizer for back-sync changes (in seconds, minimum 60)

data.description: Send POST with shotID to upload in body
POST to run a Visualizer back-sync immediately
Last back-sync result, applied count, cursor and any error
Last forward-sync result and any error

shotId.description: Local shot id to sync to Visualizer

name: Settings Viewer
author: Decent Espresso
description: Displays Decent application and machine settings in an embeddable HTML page. http://localhost:8080/api/v1/plugins/settings.reaplugin/ui

RefreshInterval.description: Auto-refresh interval in seconds (0 to disable)

body.description: Returns an HTML page displaying current Decent app and DE1 settings

name: Streamline/DYE2
author: Streamline
description: Bean, grinder, and equipment management for Decent Espresso

name: Decent Profile Generator
author: Stephane Ribes and Alwaysdialingin
description: Generates optimized espresso profiles based on bean and grind characteristics. Configure settings to match your current beans, then connect to the profileGenerated WebSocket event to receive the computed profile. The UI can also upload the generated profile to your library and load it onto the connected machine. http://localhost:8080/api/v1/plugins/decent-profile.reaplugin/ui

roastDegree.description: Roast degree. Options: Light Roast, Medium-Light Roast, Medium Roast, Medium-Dark Roast, Dark Roast

roastQuality.description: Roast quality. Options: Underdevelopped, Smoky or overroasted, Outstanding, I have no idea

origin.description: Bean origin. Options: Kenya, Ethiopia, Other Africa, Colombia, Other America, Other

highlight.description: What to highlight. Options: Body / Mouthfeel, Sweetness and acidity, Floral and fruity flavors, Chocolate and nuts flavors, I'm not sure

avoid.description: What to avoid. Options: Sourness or high acidity, Bitterness or astringency, Nothing in particular

strength.description: Desired strength. Options: Allongé (4.5 - 5.5% TDS), Low intensity (7.0 - 7.5% TDS), 7.5 - 8.0% TDS, 8.0 - 8.5% TDS, 8.5 - 9.0% TDS, Average intensity (9.0 - 9.5% TDS), 9.5 - 10% TDS, 10.5 - 11.5% TDS, High intensity (11.5 - 12.5% TDS)

basket.description: Basket type. Options: High precision double (Decent, VST), Single (Decent 7g, LM Strada 7g), High precision + paper filter below the puck, Reneka Micro-Sieve or IMS Super Fine

puckPrep.description: Puck prep quality. Options: Can be improved, OK, I am not sure

profileTitle.description: Profile title used in the output file (default: "Your Next Decent Profile")

profileFormat.description: Output format: legacy-tcl or json-v2 (default: legacy-tcl)

layout.description: UI layout. Options: baseline (two-column workspace, Inter font, orange accent) or decent (single-column stacked, green accent). Default: decent

profile.description: Full generated profile text ready to load on the machine

name: Decent shot upload
author: Decent Espresso
description: Uploads your espresso shots to your Decent account at decentespresso.com so you can see your shot history and charts. Uses your existing Decent login; only your own machines are accepted. Off by default: enable Upload shots automatically to opt in.

AutoUpload.description: Upload shots automatically when they finish (opt-in; off by default)

LengthThreshold.description: Only upload shots longer than this many seconds (skips flushes)

data.description: POST to upload the latest shot now (from the currently-connected machine)
